{{Quote|At least the New Republic can evacuate the next target before they show.''"<br />"''Yes. Let's see what happens at New Holgha.|[[Goran Beviin]] and Boba Fett discuss the upcoming Yuuzhan Vong attack|<ref name="BF" />}}
'''New Holgha''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]], known for its [[Five Holy Cities]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], it was easily [[Battle of New Holgha|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], believing [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] intelligence on the upcoming attack to be untrustworthy, relocated New Holgha's defense force elsewhere.

==Description==
New Holgha was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Shirb system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="BF" /> Located in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]], it was linked to the [[Shaum Hii system/Legends|Shaum Hii]] and [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth systems]] by the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its surface featured [[Tree/Legends|tree]] cover.<ref name="BF" />

==History==
{{Quote|The New Republic didn't believe us. Well, maybe they'll believe us now.|[[Goran Beviin]] witnesses the attack on New Holgha|<ref name="BF" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in between [[24 ABY/Legends|24]] and [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], dates the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of New Holgha|attack]] on New Holgha to three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the beginning of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to 25 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. Therefore, the attack must also take place in 25 ABY.</ref> New Holgha was held by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] before it was [[Battle of New Holgha|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Although the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalorian leader]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], had passed on intelligence to the New Republic citing the world as the Yuuzhan Vong's next target, the New Republic did not trust the source, as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were publicly allied with the Yuuzhan Vong. New Holgha was not evacuated, and its [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was redeployed to the New Republic stronghold on the astronomical object [[Pedd Four]]. Following this, New Holgha's planetary defense [[Radar/Legends|radar]] was [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] [[Standard day/Legends|overnight]], and the world subsequently fell without significant resistance.<ref name="BF" />

Fett betrayed the Yuuzhan Vong as the invaders laid waste to New Holgha's [[Five Holy Cities]], and began passing future intelligence on the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] invaders to a more reliable source&mdash;the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]], whom Fett and his [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|comrades]] rescued from a Yuuzhan Vong attack.<ref name="BF" /> Following the attack, the Shirb [[Star system/Legends|system]] became part of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], and remained under its control until the Yuuzhan Vong were [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|defeated]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|They redeployed troops to defend Pedd Four. So they think we gave them misinformation.|Goran Beviin, on the New Republic's withdrawal of the New Holgha garrison|<ref name="BF" />}}
Inhabitants of the planet were known as [[New Holghan]]s. The New Republic stationed a garrison of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] on New Holgha before moving it to Pedd Four prior to the Yuuzhan Vong conquest of the planet.<ref name="BF" />

==Locations==
New Holgha was home to the Five Holy Cities,<ref name="BF" /> for which it was famous.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|374|New Holgha}}</ref> The [[City/Legends|cities]] were based around a large marketplace and featured tall buildings.<ref name="BF" />

==Behind the scenes==
New Holgha first appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', a [[2006]] [[eBook]] written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="BF" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shirb system, and therefore New Holgha, in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
